implementation.strategy: Keep at most one successfully cleaned, uninvoked context worker idle; rebuild session and per-handler STA/COM/menu state for every query
implementation.release_ack: Private RSP_PONG(session) only after CtxSessionThreadImpl returns, handler threads join, menus/COM bindings are released and session COM apartments are uninitialized; no acknowledgement after handler exception

implementation.com_release_order: Query-time CtxBind is released before publication and before handler CoUninitialize; menu COM state remains on the original handler STA until normal release
implementation.visible_window_check: Checked both before requesting cleanup and after receiving the release acknowledgement
